name: ai.poyo/mcp
title: PoYo AI Models
description: Search, price and run chat, image, video, audio and 3D AI models through one PoYo API key.

tools.name: poyo_search_models
tools.description: Search PoYo's live model catalog: chat models (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Kimi) and image, video, audio and 3D generation models. Returns model IDs with category, tags, protocols and input schema, paged with next_cursor. Free, no API key needed.

query.description: Free-text search, e.g. kling, veo, nano banana or claude.

service_type.description: chat for language models, generate for image, video, audio and 3D generation.

category.description: Optional category filter, e.g. video, image, audio or chat.

tags.description: Optional tags every result must carry.

tools.name: poyo_get_model_schema
tools.description: Get one model's input and output schema, supported protocols and examples. Call it before running a model so the input uses only documented fields. Free, no API key needed.

model.description: PoYo model ID from poyo_search_models, e.g. gpt-6-luna, claude-sonnet-5-5 or kling-4.0.

tools.name: poyo_get_pricing
tools.description: Get one model's public credit price (per request, per token, per image or per second, depending on the model). Free, no API key needed.

model.description: PoYo model ID from poyo_search_models, e.g. gpt-6-luna, claude-sonnet-5-5 or kling-4.0.

tools.name: poyo_chat
tools.description: Run one non-streaming chat request on a PoYo chat model and return the full response, with token usage and the credits charged in _poyo. SPENDS CREDITS from the account's PoYo balance: check the price with poyo_get_pricing, tell the user which model will run and what it costs, and get their confirmation first.

model.description: PoYo model ID from poyo_search_models, e.g. gpt-6-luna, claude-sonnet-5-5 or kling-4.0.

protocol.description: Request format of input: openai-chat (default, messages), openai-responses, anthropic (Messages API) or gemini (generateContent).

input.description: The request body in the chosen protocol, e.g. {"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Hi"}],"max_tokens":200}. model and stream are set by the server.

tools.name: poyo_run_model
tools.description: Start an image, video, audio or 3D generation and wait up to wait_seconds for the result. Returns the task with status queued, running, succeeded or failed; if it is not finished, poll poyo_check_job with its task_id instead of submitting again. SPENDS CREDITS from the account's PoYo balance: check the price with poyo_get_pricing, tell the user which model will run and what it costs, and get their confirmation first.

model.description: PoYo model ID from poyo_search_models, e.g. gpt-6-luna, claude-sonnet-5-5 or kling-4.0.

input.description: The model's input fields exactly as listed by poyo_get_model_schema. Images, video and audio go in as public HTTPS URLs.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the result, 0 to 30 seconds. Default 30.

tools.name: poyo_submit_job
tools.description: Submit a generation job and return its task_id at once; use it for video and other long jobs. Poll poyo_check_job every 10 to 30 seconds until status is succeeded or failed. SPENDS CREDITS from the account's PoYo balance: check the price with poyo_get_pricing, tell the user which model will run and what it costs, and get their confirmation first.

model.description: PoYo model ID from poyo_search_models, e.g. gpt-6-luna, claude-sonnet-5-5 or kling-4.0.

input.description: The model's input fields exactly as listed by poyo_get_model_schema. Images, video and audio go in as public HTTPS URLs.

callback_url.description: Optional HTTPS URL PoYo posts the result to when the job ends. Omit it and poll poyo_check_job instead.

tools.name: poyo_check_job
tools.description: Get the status of a generation task (queued, running, succeeded or failed), its output file URLs on success and the error on failure. Free.

task_id.description: The task_id returned by poyo_submit_job, poyo_run_model or a model tool.

tools.name: poyo_list_jobs
tools.description: List the account's recent generation tasks, newest first, with task_id, model, status, credits and timestamps. Use it to find a job again after a disconnect or in a new session, then call poyo_check_job for its outputs. Free.

limit.description: How many recent tasks to return, 1 to 50. Default 20.

model.description: Optional PoYo model ID filter, e.g. kling-4.0.

tools.name: poyo_upload_file
tools.description: Upload a local image, audio or video file (base64, up to 20 MB) and get a temporary public HTTPS URL to pass as a model input. Files expire after 72 hours. Free; limited to 10 uploads per minute.

data.description: The file as base64, or a base64 data URL (data:image/png;base64,...). Up to 20 MB. JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG, FLAC, MP4, MOV or WebM; the type is detected from the file content.

tools.name: poyo_account
tools.description: Read the account behind the API key: plan, status and remaining credits. Free.
